This adverse development was primarily driven by an increase in industry loss estimates for Typhoon Jebi (2018 event), leading to loss reserve strengthening in the Treaty Property and Third-party Liability classes. The report also mentions other major losses from 2019 pacific typhoon events (Lekima, Faxai, Hagibis) impacting the current year.
